title: EVALUATING TWITTER'S ALGORITHMIC AMPLIFICATION OF LOW-CREDIBILITY CONTENT: AN OBSERVATIONAL STUDY

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring algorithmic amplification by comparing impression counts of tweets linking to low-credibility versus high-credibility domains using a bias-corrected and accelerated bootstrapping (BCa) model stratified by engagement and follower counts.

Evaluating algorithmic amplification differences between right-leaning and left-leaning content by classifying URL domains using GPT-4 and adding political stance as an additional stratification variable in the impression benchmarking model.
